correctness.rationale: At frozen actual 6a4790 tree the precise D6,3 complex has vertices the 15 edges of K6 and faces graph edge sets with no dominating pair. A fresh independent 2^15 enumeration gives 4502 nonempty simplices and face vector (15,105,455,1185,1647,915,180); exact unit-pivot integral boundary reductions independently return ranks (14,91,364,821,711,180). Thus H4 rank115, H5 rank24 with no other positive-degree homology or torsion. The action on im ∂5 is computed in an integral triangular basis; for identity/transposition/six-cycle, independent trace reductions give χ5=24,8,0, agreeing with (fix(g)−1)^2−1. The source full character table on 11 S6 cycle types and Murnaghan–Nakayama decomposition imply the claimed H5 Spechts (5,1),(4,2),(4,1,1) and the nine listed H4 constituents, no trivial summand. Finite-group rational averaging makes the orbit space rationally acyclic (not contractible). The independent check did not replay all 11 class traces; their finite source verifier was inspected in full.
